def smallest_lcs(a: str, b: str) -> str:
    n, m = len(a), len(b)

    # dp[i][j] = LCS length of a[:i], b[:j]
    dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        ai = a[i - 1]
        row = dp[i]
        prev = dp[i - 1]
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            if ai == b[j - 1]:
                row[j] = prev[j - 1] + 1
            else:
                x = prev[j]
                y = row[j - 1]
                row[j] = x if x >= y else y

    # next_a[i][c] = smallest index >= i where a[index] == c, or n if none
    next_a = [None] * (n + 1)
    cur = {}
    next_a[n] = cur
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        cur = dict(cur)
        cur[a[i]] = i
        next_a[i] = cur

    next_b = [None] * (m + 1)
    cur = {}
    next_b[m] = cur
    for j in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
        cur = dict(cur)
        cur[b[j]] = j
        next_b[j] = cur

    target_len = dp[n][m]
    i = j = 0
    res = []
    while target_len > 0:
        chosen = None
        chosen_p = chosen_q = -1
        # Try characters in lexicographic order.
        for c in sorted(next_a[i].keys()):
            p = next_a[i].get(c, n)
            q = next_b[j].get(c, m)
            if p < n and q < m and dp[p][q] + 1 == target_len:
                chosen = c
                chosen_p = p
                chosen_q = q

            break

        i = chosen_p + 1
        j = chosen_q + 1
        target_len -= 1

    return ''.join(res)
